title: Flatness over a base is detected after a faithfully flat intermediate extension
statement: Let $A\to B\to C$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], let $N$ be a $B$-module [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] with its $A$-module structure induced by $A\to B$, and suppose $C$ is faithfully flat as a $B$-module [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. Give $C\otimes_B N$ its $A$-module structure through $A\to B\to C$. Then $N$ is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] if and only if $C\otimes_B N$ is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 0584 (lemma-flatness-descends-more-general, line 8930), part (2), with R=A, S=B, S'=C, M=N; the same argument appears in the proof of Morphisms Tag 02JZ (lemma-flat-permanence)
